tone.summary: A clean, chorused signal chain utilizing the UK SLP/UK 45 combination for a bright, mid-focused hard rock sound, enhanced by Chorus and Room reverb.
corrections: Shift from generic mid-gain to brighter polished 80s crunch.
Make chorus more obvious; it is part of the signature.
Keep gain moderate, not overdriven metal.
